feature: Extract duplicated list view pagination/filtering into reusable utility
workflow_rationale: This is a refactoring task to eliminate code duplication across 14+ list views. We'll follow the Add New → Migrate → Cleanup pattern to ensure existing functionality continues working during the transition.

phases.name: Create Reusable List Utility
phases.description: Build the new reusable list_utils.py module with pagination and filtering utilities that can be used by function-based views

subtasks.description: Create apps/core/list_utils.py with FilterConfig and apply_list_filters utility function

verification.command: python -c "from apps.core.list_utils import apply_list_filters, FilterConfig; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: ✅ Created FilterConfig class and apply_list_filters function with support for search filters, field filters, custom filters, date range filtering, pagination, and ordering. Verified imports work correctly.

subtasks.description: Create tests/test_list_utils.py with unit tests for the utility functions
subtasks.notes: ✅ Created comprehensive test suite with 33 unit tests covering FilterConfig, apply_list_filters, and apply_date_range_filter. All tests pass successfully. Tests cover search filters, field filters, custom filters, pagination, ordering, date range filtering, and edge cases.
